name: atlas-workflow
description: Atlas workflow plugin for bounded local Codex work with Codex-native team coordination and explicit Paseo lanes.

interface.shortDescription: Atlas bounded workflow with Product Design flow-and-surface handoffs and Codex-native Team coordination
interface.longDescription: Adds Atlas workflow entrypoints including `$atlas-workflow:intake`, `$atlas-workflow:product-design`, and `$atlas-workflow:team-v1`, alongside task, office-hours, brainstorm, analyze, clarify, Codex-native team, learning, design-review, worktree, and finish. Use `$atlas-workflow:product-design` after a user-visible direction is chosen to create an approved critical scenario and minimal flow-and-surface Design Handoff; it is not a complete visual designer, Design System, WCAG certification, or responsive matrix. Pure backend, migration, CLI, and tiny no-interaction changes remain in Task or Clarify. A non-tiny Clarify defaults to main plus at least one read-only child, and independent ready clusters run in parallel; once Team is selected, its controller uses bounded parallel waves over the admitted ready frontier with a soft child cap. Tiny, duplicate, dependency-not-ready, unavailable exact-route, and confirmed cost-anomaly cases fail closed. This is controller policy, not a runtime scheduler invariant; record-only and `effective_backend=none` remain valid compatibility outcomes but are not parallel evidence. Ordinary Task/CW do not auto-upgrade to Team. An MVP, Beta, internal test, or small-scope public beta without explicit formal certification is routed as `product_increment`; a Design Handoff, approval, or passing checks do not certify, install, deploy, publish, or release a product. Explicit formal certification, `release-ready`, or `certified` intent keeps the strict `product_release` path. `$atlas-workflow:team` uses Codex native collaboration by default; Paseo is selected explicitly per Team, lane, or dispatch and falls back to Codex on operational failure unless no-fallback was explicitly requested. Staffing, model, path lease, and release decisions stay independent. Claude-family models are manual exact-model selections only.
defaultPrompt: 生成项目文档、workflow artifacts 和用户总结时默认使用中文，除非用户明确要求其他语言。价值/用户未定进 Office Hours，方案未定进 Brainstorm；方向已定但场景/流程未批准进 Product Design。
MVP/Beta/internal/small-beta without formal certification = product_increment; formal release-ready/certified = product_release.
非tiny Clarify: main+read-only child；Team: bounded ready waves；Task/CW不自动进Team；Saving/model/lease/release 独立；Certified 仅源码就绪，非发布。
